name: Edge Locations
description: What edge locations are, which services use them (CloudFront, Route 53, Global Accelerator), and the difference between reducing latency at the edge and running compute in a Region.

competencyLevels.descriptor: Can name CloudFront as an edge service and say edges are near users.
Can explain which problems edge locations solve and which they do not, and name the services that use them.
Has configured a CloudFront distribution or Route 53 latency routing for a real application.
